steps.title: In plain English
steps.goal: Before YAML: learn the small payments API domain, then answer ask, send, return, and wrong for PaymentIntent, Capture, Refund, and WebhookEvent in your own words.

steps.title: Smallest valid spec
steps.goal: Turn one ask and one return into openapi + info + GET /payment_intents/{id} with 200.

steps.title: Name the thing
steps.goal: Name the return shape once in components/schemas and $ref it from the 200.

steps.title: Create
steps.goal: Translate send into POST /payment_intents with a JSON body and required create fields.

steps.title: Failure
steps.goal: Translate wrong into a shared Error schema plus 400 and 404 on payment intent ops.

steps.title: Lists
steps.goal: Expand ask with GET /payment_intents, query filters, and pagination params.

steps.title: Auth
steps.goal: Translate credential notes under send into a security scheme and apply it.

steps.title: From scratch
steps.goal: Apply ask/send/return/wrong to the payments worksheet and type the full PaymentIntent, Capture, Refund, and WebhookEvent YAML by hand.
